modelling.depth: Common estimated main frame depth 0.135 m behind each brick face, frame varies 0.120–0.200 m. No measured survey of rebate depth. Profiles and main divisions measured on 2023 exposure.
modelling.condition: Eight photo axes are indices from left to right, distinct from street addresses. Curved timber heads sit below separate pointed brick dressings; four middle third-storey lights have shallow segmental heads.
modelling.lower_08: Dark grille and partial front plant overlap panes; preserve outer opening and ledge, a separate iron grille, and only visible exposed sash lines.
